content.text: The project was created to display all the files of various libraries created by the Turbotech Developer Team. This project is called `SmartERP Component`. Any installation or other use of the created Library will be displayed in this Project, categorized by Library.
For developer can find the project repository, please visit the following link: [https://github.com/turbotechlabs/smart-component](https://github.com/turbotechlabs/smart-component).
Generate Key for the environment file:

| Param | Value | Use for |
|-------|-------|---------|
| `selector` | none | Require table (class, id, attr, tag) you want to export |
| `fileName` | Excel | Set excel file name |
| `sheetName` | fileName | Set excel sheet name |
| `title` | fileName | Set header title |
| `titleKh` | none | Set header Khmer title |
| `subtitle` | none | Set header Subtitle |
| `dateFrom` | null | Set date from in header |
| `dateTo` | null | Set date to in header |
| `customDate` | null | Customize date you want (HTML, CSS) |
| `extension` | .xls | Set excel extension |
| `select` | true | Show or hide select tag when export |
| `checkbox` | true | Show or hide checkbox when export |
| `fontSize` | 15px | Set excel font size |
| `fontHeadEn` | Times New Roman | Set excel header font-family title |
| `fontHeadKh` | Khmer OS Muol Light | Set excel header font-family Khmer title |
| `removeCell` | none | Remove item(s) with (class, id, attr, tag) |
| `zoom` | 100 | Set zoom percent when export |
| `image{src}` | none | Set header image url |
| `image{width}` | 133 | Set header image width |
| `image{height}` | auto | Set header image height |
| `image{alt}` | Turbotech | Set header image alt |
| `border` | none | Set table border width (thin, 1px, etc) |
| `borderStyle` | none | Set table border style (solid, dotted, double, etc) |
| `borderColor` | none | Set table border color (rgb, hex, etc) |
| `tableBorder` | none | Set only table border outside |
| `setTopTheadHTML` | none | Customize header on top of table (HTML, CSS) |
| `setTheadHTML` | none | Customize table's thead (HTML, CSS) |
| `setTfootHTML` | none | Customize table's footer (HTML, CSS) |
| `setHeaderHTML` | none | Customize header (HTML, CSS) |
| `setFooterHTML` | none | Customize footer (HTML, CSS) |
| `footer{show}` | false | Show or hide footer for signature |
| `footer{topstart}` | 1 | Set top start point from table |
| `footer{leftspan}` | 1 | Set signature left span |
| `footer{rightspan}` | 1 | Set signature right span |
| `footer{inner}` | true | Set inner table footer (include border with table) |
